GenAiFunction.description: Extracts contact IDs from formatted text and adds them as deal experts to navpeII__Deal_Team__c. Run this action only if Get Related Deal Info has run already in the conversation The user is selecting contacts from a numbered list. Rules: - If the user means all contacts, set selectionMode = "ALL". - If the user selects specific contacts by number, set selectionMode = "INDEX". - When selectionMode = "INDEX", extract ONLY the numbers and return them as a comma-separated list (example: "1,3"). - Do NOT include words, spaces, or punctuation in selectedIndexes. - Do NOT invent numbers.
